content.text: Monty without going into too much detail  can you tell me what skills you have

I have 15 skills available for specific tasks:

- browser-automation (web page control)
- canvas (HTML presentation on node canvases)
- diagram-maker (SVG/HTML/Excalidraw diagrams)
- healthcheck (host auditing/hardening)
- meme-maker (meme template search/generation)
- node-connect (node pairing/diagnosis)
- node-inspect-debugger (Node.js debugging)
- notion (Notion CLI/API operations)
- python-debugpy (Python debugging)
- skill-creator (Skill Workshop management)
- spike (throwaway prototypes)
- taskflow (multi-step task coordination)
- taskflow-inbox-triage (inbox triage pattern)
- video-frames (video frame/clip extraction)
- weather (current weather/forecasts)

Each skill has a specific purpose and version hash for verification. Let me know if you'd like details on any particular skill.
